name: to-teach
description: Create classroom-ready worksheets, presentations, lesson plans, and interactive exercises from a topic or source. Open results in to-teach to edit, share with students, collect responses, or export to PDF and LMS formats.

interface.longDescription:
Create worksheets, presentations, lesson plans, and interactive exercises from a topic or source. Edit existing worksheets with a written instruction. Open results in to-teach to review, edit, share with students, collect responses, or export to PDF and LMS formats.

A to-teach account is required. Creation and editing use your account’s available quotas. Jobs run asynchronously; the plugin provides progress links and links to completed materials. Review AI-generated materials before classroom use.
defaultPrompt: Create a worksheet about photosynthesis for ages 12–13.
Create a presentation about the water cycle for ages 9–10.
Create a 45-minute lesson plan about renewable energy.

positive.description: Create a complete worksheet from a topic.
positive.prompt: Use to-teach to create a worksheet about photosynthesis for students aged 12–13 in English.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts the worksheet job, reports its progress, and returns a link to the completed worksheet.

positive.description: Create a classroom presentation from a topic.
positive.prompt: Use to-teach to create a presentation about the water cycle for students aged 9–10 in English.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts the presentation job, reports its progress, and returns a link to the completed presentation.

positive.description: Create a timed lesson plan with a teaching-method focus.
positive.prompt: Use to-teach to create a 45-minute lesson plan about renewable energy for students aged 14–15, with a focus on group work.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts the lesson-plan job, reports its progress, and returns a link to the completed lesson plan.

positive.prompt: Use to-teach to create an interactive matching exercise for beginner French vocabulary for students aged 11–12.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts the interactive-exercise job, reports its progress, and returns a link to the completed exercise.

positive.description: Process a public source before creating a grounded worksheet.
positive.prompt: Use to-teach to process https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Plate_tectonics and create an English worksheet based on it for students aged 13–14.
positive.expected_behavior: Processes and privately saves the source, then creates and returns a grounded worksheet after both jobs complete.

negative.description: Do not trigger for standalone image generation.
negative.prompt: Generate a standalone photorealistic image of a volcano.
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not be invoked because it does not offer standalone image generation.

negative.description: Do not trigger for standalone audio generation.
negative.prompt: Create and download an MP3 narration of this paragraph.
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not be invoked because it does not offer standalone audio generation.

negative.description: Do not trigger when the user only asks for an explanation.
negative.prompt: Explain photosynthesis to me in three sentences.
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not be invoked because the user did not request creation of a teaching material.

publication.release_notes: Create worksheets, presentations, lesson plans, and interactive exercises from topics or source materials. Edit worksheets and follow generation progress. This submission includes five positive and three negative review scenarios and a live video walkthrough.
